commands.adaptedInvariant: The apple-container runtime lifecycle and per-file UDS (vsock / --publish-socket) proxy topology are the named adapted equivalent of the Docker resource-lifecycle and UDS-mount gates; availability-gated on checkAppleContainerAvailable and green on the apple-container qualification host.

commands.rationale: The Docker network-allocation/lease lifecycle gate exercises the Docker sidecar topology; apple-container's runtime lifecycle is proven by the executed apple-container-integration gate.

The Docker cgroup resource-limit gate does not apply: apple-container enforces CPU/memory as host-authoritative hypervisor limits and guest PIDs are unsupported by threat-model decision; the apple resource arguments are covered by the executed apple-container-manager gate.

The Docker --internal + tcp-sidecar isolation gate does not apply; the same no-egress invariant is proven for apple-container by the executed apple-container-manager --network none coverage and the apple-container-integration UDS topology gate.

The Docker shared-directory UDS-mount spike does not apply; apple-container per-file --publish-socket / vsock UDS proxy reachability is proven by the executed apple-container-manager and apple-container-integration gates.

Linux rootless-sidecar UID/GID remap (issue #232) does not apply to apple-container, which translates workspace UID via VirtioFS/vsock with no host-UID equivalence claimed for the guest; the executed apple-container-manager gate proves the workspace is mounted writable (rw, not the read-only orientation mount) and path-escape mount targets are rejected. Runtime workspace write-back cooperation remains a 0C live-run assertion.

Goose agent UID/GID remap is the same Linux rootless-sidecar mechanism and does not apply to apple-container; the executed apple-container-manager gate proves the workspace is mounted writable (rw, not read-only) and path-escape mount targets are rejected. This explicit Goose disposition prevents Goose coverage from disappearing via agent auto-selection.

The entrypoint UDS-to-TCP bridge gate targets the Docker-Desktop-macOS socat sidecar; apple-container publishes the guest PTY socket via --publish-socket, whose transport is proven by the executed apple-container-manager --publish-socket coverage.

The real-Docker-container skills end-to-end gate is Docker-specific (it stages skills inside a live Docker container); no apple-container skills end-to-end gate exists in the inventory, and the backend-agnostic skill-staging assertions run in the host suite outside this contract.

Codex is a registered agent adapter (src/docker/adapters/codex.ts) but the frozen qualification inventory defines no dedicated codex integration gate; codex adapter behavior is covered by the host-side unit suite (test/codex-adapter.test.ts) outside this contract. This explicit Codex disposition records that no apple-container codex integration gate exists to execute.
